Step Contents: The cabinet stands in front of you with its tools on the table.
Voice Support: Welcome to the cabinet service task.

Step Contents: Auto Advance
Selecting 'Begin' triggers step advancement
Highlight the Cabinet Latches
Hint: -Bouncing arrow pointing at the key on the table
Voice Support: Unlock both latches with the key.

Step Contents: The user is teleported to the front view
Selecting the key places it in hand
Selecting the top latch triggers Top Latch Open Animation and returns the key to hand
Selecting the bottom latch triggers Bottom Latch Open Animation and returns the key to hand
Return the key to the table
Auto Advance when both latches are open
Highlight the door
Text On Placard: Select the door to open it

Step Contents: Selecting the door triggers Door Open Animation
Auto Advance
Highlight the bolt
Hint: -Bouncing arrow pointing at the wrench on the table
Voice Support: Remove the bolt with the wrench.

Step Contents: The user is teleported to the back view
Selecting the wrench places it in hand
Selecting the bolt with wrench in hand triggers Bolt Removal Animation
Trigger Lid Open Animation
The bolt fades away
Return the wrench to the table
Auto Advance
Selecting the button triggers step advancement
YES and NO buttons appear on the placard screen
Selecting 'YES' triggers step advancement to step B04
Selecting 'NO' triggers step advancement to step B03.5
Selecting 'Try Again' triggers step advancement to step B03
Voice Support: That is not right. Try again.

Step Contents: Selecting 'Exit' ends the task
